just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ds4 and dwells most on Ds in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:07.6) introduces Gb, centred on Ds. The line peaks at Gb4 (365.5 Hz) at 1:35.8. It closes on Gb4, not the tonic (Gb4 → Gb4 → Gb3 → Gb4 → Gb3 → Gb4).
